We need to determine correct label(s) for this case. Facts: Item: defendant runs a family-style inn, allows a prostitute (宋某) to provide sexual services to guests, including a minor (章某某) under 14. The charge: "介绍、容留卖淫罪". According to correction lessons, there is a specific label for "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫;引诱、容留、介绍卖淫" etc. The correct label list includes:

- 【组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫;协助组织卖淫】 (not just "组织卖淫")
- 【组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫;引诱、容留、介绍卖淫】 (if both sets?)

But we need to see which applies. The facts: The defendant is the inn owner, he introduced and provided venue for prostitution, and also directly arranged a minor. He didn't force or coerce? He offered accommodation and introduced prostitute. So the crimes: "介绍卖淫" and "容留卖淫". Possibly also "组织卖淫"? The correction says: If behavior includes organization, forced, inducement, harboring, introduction, list all five. In this case, does he "组织"? He is the owner, he arranged the prostitute to be there, maybe considered "组织". The correction says: "若行为人同时具备组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫的全部要件，则列出完整的五项罪名". Does he have all five? He introduced (提供信息), he harbored (提供场所), he introduced (arranged), but not forced. He may have induced? He asked the prostitute to come, but not forced. He may have "组织" meaning arranging prostitution business. The label "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫;引诱、容留、介绍卖淫" seems to be used when both full set and subset? The correction: "若行为包括招募、管理、强迫、容留或介绍他人卖淫，就应使用“组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫;协助组织卖淫”。" That's a different rule. Another correction: "若行为人同时具备组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫的全部要件，则列出完整的五项罪名；若仅实施引诱、容留、介绍卖淫，则只列出这三项，不加“协助组织卖淫”。"

Thus we need to decide if "组织" applies. The owner is facilitating prostitution business, which could be considered "组织". Usually "组织卖淫" means arranging prostitution, recruiting prostitutes, etc. Here he allowed prostitute to work in his inn, and also recruited a minor. That likely qualifies as "组织". So we have all five: 组织, 强迫?, 引诱?, 容留, 介绍. Does he use force? Not described. So maybe not "强迫". But the rule says if all five, list all. If not all, list only those present. He didn't force. So we have 组织, 引诱, 容留, 介绍. Not 强迫. So the label should be "组织、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫". However the official label list includes combined forms: "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫;引诱、容留、介绍卖淫". That's for cases where both full set and subset? Not sure.
